attributes.check1: Intelligence or Arcane or Wisdom or Divine 10
attributes.name: Mistform
attributes.powers:
Discard this card to evade a non-villain, non-henchman monster you encounter that does not have the Incorporeal trait.

Discard this card to add 2 dice to any check to defeat a barrier that has the Obstacle or Trap trait.

After playing this card, if you do not have either the Arcane or Divine skill, banish it; otherwise, you may succeed at an Arcane or Divine 12 check to recharge this card instead of discarding it.
